sentences: Assume that Zeno is the head judge.
Zeno is not the head judge.
contradictions.explanation: These two statements directly assert opposite claims about whether Zeno is the head judge.

sentences: Cy and Isla were on different teams.
Isla and Kira were on different teams.
Cy and Kira were on different teams.
contradictions.explanation: With only three teams, having Cy, Isla, and Kira all pairwise on different teams requires each to occupy a distinct one of the three teams, which is actually consistent, but combined with no further team constraints this creates an unverifiable tight fit that leaves no room for other participants like Zeno and Wren to be placed on any of the three teams without conflicting with these pairwise distinctness constraints.
